data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yoel meaning 'God is Jehovah'. This name was borne by several figures in the Old Testament, including a prophet who warned of impending doom. In Christianity, it is associated with the Archangel Jophiel, the angel of the Presence. The name Joela carries the meaning “God is Jehovah” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Joela usually hope their child will grow to embody god is jehovah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
